release.title: Version 1.1.1
release.subtitle: Smoother updates & bug fixes
improvements: Update check now waits until you finish with the update dialog – no more sudden navigation
App will not proceed to the home/welcome screen until update choice is completed
bug_fixes: Fixed an issue where the app could skip the update screen and go straight to the main app
Resolved a rare timing problem that could freeze the splash screen during mandatory updates
